thread:
Sarah: Heads up — noticed a big RI utilization drop after we shifted batch training to spot-heavy pools last month. Util went from ~86% -> 52% across p4d inventory.
Omar: ugh, numbers?
Sarah: AWS billing shows ~$82k monthly RI amortized cost, but we're only realizing ~52% usage, so effective wasted spend ~ $39k/mo. Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/.../d/1xExample
Leah: Is this mostly due to preemptions, or did we move workloads permanently to spot?
Sarah: Mostly permanent for best-effort jobs — we also enabled aggressive autoscale on spot groups. Preemption accounted for ~40% of the drop; the rest is capacity reallocation.
Andre: Do we still have the option to exchange RIs or convert to Savings Plans? RI exchange only works for convertible RIs and limited SKUs.
Cost-bot: monthly-util-report: p4d family: 52% util, p3 family: 78% util. Projected next renewal window in 28 days.
Omar: Renewal window? I thought commitments auto-roll. We have a few annual convertible RIs expiring in ~45 days.
Sarah: Correct — these are convertible 1yr. Options I see: 1) keep and try shift back some training onto reserved fleet (operational overhead), 2) exchange to different SKU/region (partial), 3) sell on marketplace (if eligible), 4) buy matching Savings Plan instead.
Leah: Quick calc: if we bring util back to 80% on p4d we'd recover ~ $25k/mo. Is that feasible without hurting throughput?
Andre: Maybe split: pin critical workloads to dedicated reserved nodes (k8s nodeAffinity + taints) and run backlog on spot. That reduces risk of underutilization.
Sarah: Also suggestion: enforce tagging so we can attribute idle hours to teams — put a daily scheduled job to shut idle k8s nodepools after 2 hours of no pods.
Omar: Can we get a fast dashboard query? Need top 5 consumers of reserved capacity and idle-time histogram.
Sarah: I'll add a one-off query to cloud-costs repo and post snapshot. Pulling metrics now.
Cost-bot: report-ready: /reports/ri-util-1764447777.csv
Leah: Thumbs up on the split approach. We should also scope exchange vs marketplace — what's the liquidity? I can handle marketplace listings if we choose.
Andre: If we buy a Savings Plan it'll cover compute flexibly but might lock us differently. Need finance ok.
Sarah: Action items: (1) Sarah -> run node affinity plan + schedule for a 2-week test; (2) Omar -> prepare dashboard query andタグ enforcement PR; (3) Leah -> evaluate marketplace sell vs exchange by EOD Friday; (4) Andre -> model Savings Plan vs RI cost over 12 months. We'll reconvene Fri 10am.
Omar: noted
Leah: on it :+1: 
Andre: will model and link sheet
Sarah: thanks — tagging finance: @Maya for visibility
Maya: thx for the ping, will chime in after Leah's marketplace numbers
Sarah: closing loop — will post interim snapshot in #eng-infra once we have the test plan.
